intro: Ukraine is a democratic republic with an elected president and parliament. Since 2022 it has been governed under martial law because of the war.

chapters.title: President and Rada
text: The president is elected directly for five years and leads defence and foreign policy. The single-chamber parliament, the Verkhovna Rada, has 450 seats and appoints the prime minister.
Ukraine's constitution does not allow elections under martial law, so the presidential and parliamentary elections due in 2024 were postponed.

facts.label: Regions
facts.value: 24 oblasts, plus Crimea, Kyiv and Sevastopol

chapters.title: Symbols and the world
text: The flag's two colours stand for a blue sky over yellow wheat fields, and the coat of arms is a golden trident. Independence Day is 24 August.
Ukraine became an EU candidate in 2022 and wants to join NATO. Much of the world supports Ukraine with weapons, money and sanctions on Russia.

keyTerms.meaning: Emergency rules during war that give the military and government extra powers.
A province or region of Ukraine.
